text_block_list.text:
To prepare for a return to the Twinkle 
Series, she decided to temporarily focus 
entirely on medical treatment.

Relying on the connections of the 
academy's trainers, and with the 
understanding and cooperation of many 
medical professionals, she devoted herself 
entirely to treatment—
And then.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I had some trouble with my legs, 
so I spent some time recuperating up in 
Hokkaido!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I recovered much faster than expected, so 
my comeback at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) is 
official!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's at Nakayama Racecourse this year, 
right? I'll start preparing all kinds of 
strategies and do my best!

“The Indomitable Umamusume, Dantsu Flame”— 
With such hype, her exceptionally fast 
return became a massive topic of 
discussion!

"Around that time, there was another topic 
that had become just as big of a deal."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S crosses the finish line 2 
and a half lengths ahead of No Reason in 
second! A dominant, champion-class 
performance!!

Having pushed through the summer, Symboli 
Kris S's unstoppable advance had begun—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is... this year. ...The Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Everything entrusted to me by them... I 
will fulfill it all right here—

"A victory would make her only the third 
in history to achieve the feat. Her entry 
into the Tenno Sho (Autumn) during her 
Classic year had been decided!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I only see Kris S-senpai now and then, but 
every time I do, she's looking sharper and 
more conditioned.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I can't let myself lose either, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Now that I've made my comeback, no 
matter what it takes, absolutely, 
positively...! I have to be the star of 
the show!

Days of balancing treatment and training 
side by side continued, and then—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised. That is an unbelievable 
recovery speed.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, when I heard you wanted to 
enter the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I wondered 
what you were thinking... There is no 
issue. But naturally, letting your guard 
down is out of the question.

Managing to finish just in the nick of 
time, the day of the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)' 
arrived—!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Looking at how everyone's doing today, the 
pace probably won't be that fast after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The key player is definitely Kris 
S-senpai. Her body was in top condition as 
usual, so starting in the second half 
today, she'll surely—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, no! Stop for a second, I need 
to relax!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I need to update Umastagram! I 
haven't touched it in a while. Let's see 
here...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... we've received an incredible amount 
of cheers on Umastagram...!

Looking at the screen shown to me, sure 
enough, hundreds of comments were lined 
up.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Blown away by your comeback. Good luck in 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!" "Your indomitable 
spirit gave me courage! Please win at all 
costs!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"‘Your constant positivity gives my life 
meaning! I'll keep cheering for you 
forever and ever!’"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...'Always'—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Once the race is over and things settle 
down today, there's something I want to 
do.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind listening, so my resolve 
doesn't waver?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's an Umastagram Live...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, I want to let the fans know that 
there's a possibility the issue with my 
leg could recur.

...Up until now, Dants Flame has basically 
only made positive statements in public.
choice_data_list:
Where is this... coming from all of a 
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I want the fans to be mentally 
prepared, just in case."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I suddenly told them, 'It 
flared up again, so I'm retiring,' they'd 
be totally shocked!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
None of you know, do you? During my 
recuperation... my condition was honestly 
so bad that I was about to retire from the 
spotlight entirely.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
And in the first place, neither my body 
nor my heart is indomitable at all—

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I was a little surprised, but... thank you 
for telling me!

text_block_list.name: Dants's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, your sudden leave for 
medical treatment had me worried. If you 
could tell me the reason, and what's 
next... it'd be a lot easier to take in, 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...If possible, before it begins rather 
than after it ends.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If everyone knows in advance, I'm sure 
it'll save everyone from getting hurt!

I was a little surprised... but in a way, 
it might be proof that she's taken a step 
closer to her fans.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I have to stay focused...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll run my heart out to the very end and 
etch the revival of 'Dants Flame' into 
everyone's hearts!

Along with that determination—the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), standing thick with 
formidable rivals, has begun!
